user_saw: iOS offered OpenClaw Share for four to ten photos or a video, but the compose sheet disabled Send.
summary: The fix limits iOS Share activation to at most three images and removes video eligibility.
reasoning: The parent of #106513 already advertised up to ten images and one movie while loading at most three images and no video attachments. I checked that #106513 added the Send block for omitted items, turning an existing mismatch into a disabled Send button. The offline history ends before the mismatch can be traced to its introduction, so I could not establish whether those selections had ever been fully supported.
